title: Doom-Coding: a guide for coding on your phone, anywhere, anytime

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Okay, wait. This is actually genius. Doom coding is a guide for coding on your phone, anywhere, anytime. Like doom scrolling but productive. The setup, TailscaleVPN, Termius terminal app, clawed code, and a computer running 24/7 at home. Once configured, you SSH into your machine from your phone and run clawed code in the terminal. The creator coded prototypes from Taiwan while traveling. built apps at the club.
